opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__facts:
By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant-Chandan, who is involved in Case Crime No. 92 of 2022, under Sections 323, 504, 376D IPC and Sections 5/6, 11/12 and 13/14 Prevention of Children from Sexual Offence (POCSO) Act and Section 67 of Information Technology (Amendment) Act, Police Station Babhani, District Sonbhadra, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
The facts of the case are that the informant who is father of the victim has lodged an FIR on 12.07.2022 at 18:45 hours against Nandan and present applicant Chandan alleging inter-alia that on 16.06.2022 when his daughter, aged about 15-16 years, was returning her home from the school,
Nandan forcefully took her to his house by lying that her family members have come to his house Chandan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186149264/
1 and committed rape on her and also threatened to kill.
Meanwhile, the present applicant Chandan had made her obscene photos and video and threatened her not to tell anyone and if he did not listen to them, they would make the said video viral.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__arguments:
He next submits that on 18.06.2022, applicant was not present in his house as he was in the State of Gujarat,
therefore, there was no question of clicking photos and recording the obscene video of the victim on the date of incident i.e. 18.06.2022.
The main allegation of rape is against co-accused Nandan.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__ANALYSIS:
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that after culmination of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed against the applicant and co-accused Nandan under Sections 323, 504, 376 (DA) IPC, Sections 5/6, 11/12, 13/14 of POCSO Act and Section 67 of IT Act.
There is no material on record to presume that on the date of incident, applicant was in the State of Gujarat.
As on date, I do not find any material on record to presume the false implication of the applicant and to disbelieve the statement of the victim.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the submissions advanced on behalf of parties, gravity of offence, role assigned to applicant and severity of punishment, I do not find any good ground to release the applicant on bail.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__decision:
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected at this stage.
It is made clear that the observation contained in the instant order is confined to the issue of bail and shall not affect the merit of the trial.

The applicant is in jail since 31.10.2023 and has no criminal history.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused; submissions of the learned counsel for the parties noted above; finding force in the submissions made by the learned counsel for the applicant; keeping view the uncertainty regarding conclusion of trial; one sided investigation by police, ignoring the case of accused side; applicant being under-trial having fundamental right to speedy trial; larger mandate of the Article 21 of the Constitution of India;
considering the dictum of Apex Court in the recent judgment dated 11.07.2022 of the Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil vs. C.B.I., passed in S.L.P (Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021
opennyai_summary.16_December_2023__ANALYSIS:
The Apex Court in the cases of Sonu @ Subhash Kumar Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and another, 2021 0 Supreme (SC) 182, Promod Suryabhan Pawar Vs. State of Maharastra and others,
MANU/SC/1142/2019, Dhruvaram Murlidhar Sonar Vs. State of Maharastra and others,

2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
4.
That the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
